source_semantics.authoritative_value: Each rendered Sites row uses the persisted site's SiteUrl value returned by the tenant-scoped Sites read model.
source_semantics.link_behavior: The source renders SiteUrl as the visible anchor text and href, opens it in a new tab, and applies noopener.
source_semantics.read_only: Opening the URL is navigation only; it does not mutate local state, enqueue work, or fabricate provider success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/sites-site-url-link-control.tsx binds AIMW-CONT-44A3B8E551 only to the Sites SiteUrl external link.
laravel_adaptation.workspace_wiring: resources/js/pages.tsx renders the control only for the real Sites ResourceContent rows using site_url when present and the existing authoritative url field as the compatibility alias.
laravel_adaptation.url_safety: Only absolute credential-free HTTP(S) URLs are rendered. Unsafe or malformed values fail closed with no synthetic fallback link.
laravel_adaptation.read_contract: The link consumes the Sites query row already returned for the active tenant; it performs no additional request and no mutation.

tenant_isolation.active_tenant: The Sites workspace and Sites query are resolved for the authenticated active tenant; foreign tenant workspaces fail closed.
tenant_isolation.authoritative_row: The visible URL comes from the tenant-owned Site row, never from user-entered client state.

proofs: exact canonical operation identity and non-mutation metadata
source-equivalent visible URL and external-link semantics
production operation marker only on the real Sites URL link control
legacy url compatibility still points to the same authoritative Site row value
unsafe schemes, credentials, relative URLs and malformed values fail closed
tenant-scoped Sites data excludes foreign tenant rows
